name: breakthrough-on-three-files
description: Breakthrough shrunk to a strip three files wide and five rows long, one row of three runners a side. Each runner steps straight or diagonally forward and takes diagonally; the first to reach the far row, or to take every enemy runner, wins.
summary: Three runners a side on a board three squares wide and five long.
A runner steps one square straight or diagonally forward, and takes only diagonally.
Reach the far row, or take every enemy runner, to win.

provenance.note: Built for the labelled set (docs/reference/labelled-set.md, R-S2b2).
